# iNEXT

## Region 1

```{r}
m_tax_mer <- iNEXT(mur_tax_mer, q=c(0, 1, 2), datatype="abundance")
m_tax_mer$iNextEst$coverage_based

m_tax_mer_sub <- data.frame(m_tax_mer$iNextEst$coverage_based)
m_tax_mer_sub <- subset(m_tax_mer_sub, Method == "Observed")
m_tax_mer_sub
```
